purpose: Prospective teacher comparison under the minimal gel-v2 plus FINISH profile at the exact historical physical anchor. Environment admission is source/input/mechanics integrity, not reference-teacher success.

anchor_reference.current_evaluator_recheck: valid strict support-verified placement retained, thresholds identical

fixed_scene.units: meters, kilograms, seconds, radians; UR controller base frame; Z up

gripper.geometry_source: Rounded pad/backing contact hulls and70mm effective custom-pad aperture fitted against measured grasp; nominal bare Robotiqstroke remains85mm. Contact/material parameters are uncalibrated estimates.

camera.source: artifacts/isaac_waffles/evidence/camera_refinement_frozen_physics.json; balancedC, September4 fitting only, no hardware optical calibration.

uncertainty.geometry: Table, bin, mat, packet and custom pad sizes are visual estimates; no ruler or calibrated extrinsics recovered.
uncertainty.physics: Packet is a rigid collision body. Wrapper flex, wafer fracture, gel friction/compliance and motor response remain uncalibrated.
uncertainty.camera: Camera fit is episode-specific; do not pool sessions with changed camera mounting.

calibration.physical_fit: Two fixed fit episodes; table plane, rounded contact hulls, effective aperture and per-episode initial packet pose estimated from images/contact events. No object attachment or pose replay.
calibration.validation: Recorded-motion reproduction; does not establish calibrated force/tactile transfer or policy success.

common_inputs.latency_mode: native measured inference and actual delivery; no latency override

terminal_veto.provenance: Episode teacher5016 direct p_close,p_none,retries,floor; remaining task defaults recovered from recorded git fd4a032. live selects newer native pad-based recovery logic.

common_inputs.fixed_waffle_policy: No object offsets or appearance changes after anchor freeze; varied arm starts only in a separate later study.

terminal_veto.provenance: Episode teacher5016 direct p_close,p_none,retries,floor; remaining task defaults recovered from recorded git fd4a032. live selects newer native pad-based recovery logic.

teacher_screen.profile: Exact minimal gel-v2 + FINISH profile; no reference-teacher policy-success gate.

confirmation.candidates: Exactly the two complete valid matched-screen leaders, no substitutions
confirmation.statistical_unit: Matched sampling seed at one fixed physical start; this is not across-arm-start or hardware robustness evidence.

outcome_definitions.strict_physical_full_task: Existing evaluator outcomes.full_task with require_support_verified_release=true: ordered acquisition/lift/carry, released/settled oriented packet inside bin, positive bin support and robot unloading. Later stops are separately retained and do not erase prior physical completion.
outcome_definitions.clean_finish: Physical full task plus final bin containment/unloading/positive support and completed_reason=placement_release_finished with no actual stop; secondary outcome only.
outcome_definitions.pre_placement_safety_stop: Actual safety stop before first physical full_task time, or any actual safety stop if no physical full_task occurs.
outcome_definitions.post_placement_safety_stop: Actual safety stop after independently verified physical full_task; report timing and final object state.
outcome_definitions.release_flags: Release commits, Robotiq OBJ/latch, planner events or FINISH alone never establish physical success.

profile_freeze_rule: Minimal gel-v2 plus FINISH on original-v1 runtime. Historical fd4a032/request-time veto, pad-only wrist proxy, original safety thresholds, physics and inputs remain unchanged. No profile or candidate changes based on diagnostic or prospective results.

confirmation_rule.paired_difference: Leader minus runner-up strict physical placement rate
confirmation_rule.bootstrap_unit: Resample12 paired seed rows, preserving candidate pairing.
confirmation_rule.otherwise: conditional ranked leader / pickup candidate / inconclusive as supported; no forced winner, no threshold changes, no adaptive extra seeds to reach significance.

small_sample_guard.method: Exact two-sided discordant-pair binomial test (McNemar exact), p=min(1,2*BinomialCDF(min(n10,n01);n10+n01,.5)); no discordance p=1
small_sample_guard.rationale: Small paired binary samples can give overconfident percentile-bootstrap intervals with few one-direction discordant pairs; exact conditional test is frozen alongside the descriptive interval.

confirmation_rule.winner_label: Clear physical-placement winner at this fixed simulator anchor only; normal-finish and arm-start robustness remain separate claims.

invalid_trial_rule: Require all planned matched rows valid before selection. Retain failures and timeouts caused by the actual policy/controller. Missing/truncated/provenance-mismatched infrastructure records remain invalid, never silently omitted or relabeled; any exact-cell rerun must be explicitly recorded as a new attempt with reason, without replacing original outputs.
secondary_arm_start_rule: Not part of the64-trial core. Only after anchor reproduction and checkpoint confirmation, freeze a separate fixed-waffle measured-arm-start robustness design; no reuse of these counts as across-start success evidence.
known_limitations: Historical cell selected because it succeeded, so reproduction is conditioned on that discovery; only new reserved seeds evaluate prospective performance at the anchor.
One fixed physical scene/start does not establish unseen-start, session or hardware performance.
RGB, rigid contacts, tactile/wrist transfer and material parameters remain estimated; source/input equality does not guarantee deterministic closed-loop physics or latency.
NFE5/K4 is supported but may incur higher native latency; this remains part of that declared recipe performance and cannot trigger silent exclusion.
A no-winner conclusion remains possible; report observed physical performance and uncertainty plainly.
This is an amendment informed by development outcomes, not the original v3 or v4 preregistration.
Historical request-time veto and pad-only wrist proxy remain intentional benchmark limitations; this does not claim an identical current native deployment executor.
Reference-teacher development failure cannot establish that another teacher will fail, nor can mechanics reproduction establish prospective policy success.
freeze_authorization: Parent authorized after both combined-v4 bridge failures and before any prospective model scores. Minimal-profile development results do not admit, exclude or change candidates/profile.

supersedes.reason: Both combined-profile bridge trials stopped; the original v4 gate is failed and no v4 model score is allowed.

development_basis.minimal_profile: Gel-only development succeeded2/2 while legacy baseline0/2; combined modern-profile bridge failed2/2. Only gel correction and FINISH are retained for this newly declared comparison.
development_basis.no_teacher_admission_gate: Reference ftA1500 diagnostic success is not required. All four model candidates remain scheduled regardless of these development outcomes.

mechanics_audit.meaning: Historical accepted commands reproduce strict support-verified placement; this is mechanics evidence, not a new policy win.

execution_admission.input_inference_validation: Hash-linked in the mechanics audit: identical saved observations reproduce original native proposals bitwise.
execution_admission.source_audit: Before any model execution, freeze a SHA256-bound audit of the minimal source, allowed4file gel/FINISH delta and original input integrity. Bind that audit in the executable screen and carry the identical binding into confirmation.
